label: arbitrary
contract: An entry's lifetime is counted from its most recent put: putting the key again restarts it, and reading the entry with get does not.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(10, 30)
cache.put("a", "A", 100)
cache.put("b", "B", 100)
assert cache.get("a", 120) == "A"
cache.put("b", "B2", 125)
assert cache.get("a", 140) is None, "reading a must not extend its lifetime"
assert cache.get("b", 145) == "B2", "putting b again should restart its lifetime"
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(10, 10)
cache.put("k", "v", 0)
cache.put("j", "w", 0)
assert cache.get("k", 6) == "v"
cache.put("j", "w2", 8)
assert cache.get("k", 12) is None
assert cache.get("j", 15) == "w2"

label: arbitrary
contract: An entry is no longer returned once its lifetime has fully elapsed, including at the exact moment it elapses.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(4, 10)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 3)
assert cache.get("a", 10) is None, "a should expire exactly when its lifetime elapses"
assert cache.get("b", 12) == "B"
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(5, 25)
cache.put("x", 1, 5)
cache.put("y", 2, 10)
assert cache.get("x", 30) is None
assert cache.get("y", 34) == 2

label: arbitrary
contract: When a new key is put into a full cache, the entry whose most recent put is oldest is evicted, even if it was read more recently than the others.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(2, 100)
cache.put("x", "X", 0)
cache.put("y", "Y", 1)
assert cache.get("x", 2) == "X"
cache.put("z", "Z", 3)
assert cache.get("x", 4) is None, "x should have been evicted"
assert cache.get("y", 4) == "Y" and cache.get("z", 4) == "Z"
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("p", "P", 0)
cache.put("q", "Q", 1)
cache.put("p", "P2", 2)
cache.put("r", "R", 3)
cache.put("s", "S", 4)
assert cache.get("q", 5) is None, "q should have been evicted"
assert cache.get("p", 5) == "P2" and cache.get("r", 5) == "R" and cache.get("s", 5) == "S"
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("c", "C", 2)
assert cache.get("a", 3) == "A"
cache.put("d", "D", 4)
assert cache.get("a", 5) is None
assert cache.get("b", 5) == "B" and cache.get("c", 5) == "C" and cache.get("d", 5) == "D"
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("a", "A2", 2)
cache.put("c", "C", 3)
cache.put("d", "D", 4)
assert cache.get("b", 5) is None
assert cache.get("a", 5) == "A2" and cache.get("c", 5) == "C" and cache.get("d", 5) == "D"

label: inferable
contract: Putting a key that is already stored replaces its value and never evicts another entry.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 50)
cache.put("k1", 1, 0)
cache.put("k2", 2, 0)
cache.put("k3", 3, 0)
cache.put("k2", 20, 1)
assert cache.get("k1", 2) == 1, "k1 should still be cached"
assert cache.get("k2", 2) == 20 and cache.get("k3", 2) == 3
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(2, 10)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("b", "B2", 2)
assert cache.get("a", 3) == "A"
assert cache.get("b", 3) == "B2"
